Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 17

“Know that to be indestructible by which all this is pervaded. No one is able to bring about the destruction of the imperishable.”

The self is defined by its reach rather than its location — that which pervades everything. And its safety is absolute: destroying it is not difficult, it is not the kind of thing that can be done.
